blocking_findings.title: Removing the retired DAG parser stops loading of every .exs DAG
blocking_findings.detail: config/config.exs registers `gust dag_adapter comparison: %{parser: NetworkDefense.Evaluation.Comparison.DAGParser}`. Gust resolves a parser by file extension: Adapter.parser_for_extension/1 iterates the configured adapters, and DAG folders load only files whose extension equals a configured parser extension (Gust.DAG.Parser.File.parse_folder/1). The default elixir adapter declares extension ".ex", while the retired DAGParser declares ".exs" and only delegates to Gust.DAG.Parser.Adapters.Elixir. Deleting the parser without a replacement leaves all four native .exs DAG sources unparsed, and the loader then reports them as absent.
